name: folder-guard
description: Refuses a NEW file or folder loose in ~, ~/Desktop or ~/Documents (Write, NotebookEdit, and Bash redirects/touch/mkdir/cp/mv destinations) and suggests ~/Trading, ~/YouTube, ~/AutoRank-Business, ~/Career or ~/Engineering by keyword. Edits to existing files, existing project folders and dot-folders pass. Quote- and heredoc-aware, and resolves relative paths against the shell's real cwd.
